tasks.name: Reflax Actions
tasks.desc: Pick five flax from the flax field.
tasks.notes: Pick 5 flax at the flax field south of Seers' Village.

tasks.name: Why?
tasks.desc: Walk clockwise around the big mysterious statue.
tasks.notes:
Walk clockwise around the mysterious statue which is located east of the bank in Seers' Village.
Players can run or walk around the statue. Players must start at the east end of the statue and cannot stop until they have made a full cycle, or they will have to start again. Walking around the statue without pausing is easier than running.
Players must turn off walk animations in order to complete this achievement.

tasks.name: Stir, Galahad
tasks.desc: Have Sir Galahad make you a cup of tea.
tasks.notes: Have Sir Galahad make the player a cup of tea who can be found in his house west of McGrubor's Wood.

tasks.name: La Morte D'Arthur
tasks.desc: Take a poison chalice to King Arthur.
tasks.notes:
Take a poison chalice to King Arthur at Camelot.
Poison chalice may be obtained for free from Stankers at the coal truck mine. Be careful not to drink it. After getting a poison chalice, teleport to Camelot and use the poison chalice on King Arthur at the ground floor (UK) / 1st floor (US) of Camelot Castle. Although Arthur will first state that the player has "chosen poorly", he will then correct himself and remark that he actually enjoys Stankers' concoctions.
Level 20 Agility is required to use the shortcut from the side of McGrubor's Wood to the mining site. Alternatively, players can access the mining site from the side of the Fishing Guild.

tasks.name: Another String to Your Bow
tasks.desc: Spin five bowstrings.
tasks.notes:
Spin 5 flax into bowstrings at the spinning wheel inside a small building on the 1st floor (UK) / 2nd floor (US) located in Seers' Village. Use the ladder in the building to go upstairs to the spinning wheel.
Using the Spin Flax spell from the lunar spells will not complete this achievement.

tasks.name: Bunch of Flours
tasks.desc: Fill five pots with flour from the Sinclair Mansion.
tasks.notes: Fill five pots with flour from the barrel full of flour in the kitchen of the Sinclair Mansion. Fill a single pot five times, emptying after each refill to reuse the pot.

tasks.name: Happy Hour
tasks.desc: Give five locals a glass of cider in the Forester's Arms.
other: 14 Cooking Cooking ((to brew the cider) OR)
tasks.notes:
Give five locals a glass of cider or mature cider in the Forester's Arms in Seers' Village.
Cider may be bought at the The Esoterican Arms (located underground in Miscellania after the Royal Trouble quest) or from the Grand Exchange. It may also be created through Brewing at the Laughing Miner Pub in Keldagrim, The Green Ghost in Port Phasmatys, or the Burnt Lobster Tavern in Wendlewick.
The cider may be used on the same person five times, without having to run around.

tasks.name: Jute Alors!
tasks.desc: Plant some jute.
tasks.notes: Plant 3 jute seeds in the patch north of McGrubor's Wood. The plant does not need to be harvested, raking the patch and planting the seeds will suffice for this achievement.

tasks.name: Sinclair Swirling
tasks.desc: Use the churn in the Sinclair Mansion garden.
tasks.notes:
Use the churn in the Sinclair Mansion garden.
A bucket of milk can be obtained by using a bucket on the dairy cow in the garden. Players can alternatively obtain a bucket of milk by purchasing from the milk seller for 12 coins. The churn is just north from the stall.
Sometimes, when making butter or cheese wheels, the achievement will finish before the milk is used. Players do not have to finish churning if this occurs.

tasks.name: Grand Candle
tasks.desc: Buy a candle from the candle-maker.
tasks.notes:
Buy a white candle from the Candle-maker at Catherby docks which costs 30 coins.
Black candles will not complete the achievement.

tasks.name: A Seer-ing Light
tasks.desc: Pray at the Seers' Village altar.
tasks.notes: Pray at the altar in the church in Seers' Village or alternatively the altar at Camelot. It can be completed even with Prayer points already full.

tasks.name: Mack Rolled
tasks.desc: Catch a mackerel.
tasks.notes: Catch a raw mackerel with a big fishing net (which can be stored on the tool belt) at a Net/Harpoon fishing spot at Catherby beach. The net may be bought at Harry's Fishing Shop in Catherby.

perks: Receive 2 logs instead of 1 when cutting normal trees; grants no extra experience

Once a week, claim 210 noted flax from Geoffrey

tasks.name: Fleeing the Scene
tasks.desc: Use the Sinclair Mansion to Fremennik Province Agility shortcut.
tasks.notes:
Use the log balance shortcut between the Sinclair Mansion and the Fremennik Province.
Head north, just outside the fence of the mansion, towards the river. This achievement is boostable with items such as a summer pie.

tasks.name: It's a Slightly Magical Stick.
tasks.desc: Talk to Thormac the sorcerer about making mystic staves.
tasks.notes: Talk to Thormac the sorcerer about making mystic staves. Thormac can be found at the top of the Sorcerer's Tower south of Seers' Village. Players do not need to actually get him to enchant their staff, just talk to him about it.

tasks.name: King Coal
tasks.desc: Transport a full load (224 pieces) of coal to Seers' Village.
tasks.notes:
Transport a full load of 224 pieces of coal to Seers' Village from the coal truck mine.
Alternatively, the coal can be taken from the player's bank into the nearest Coal Truck one can deposit into. This negates the need for level 20 Mining. The fastest method is to carry the coal to the coal trucks in the small building north of the Seers' Village pub with a Beast of Burden familiar to help carry the coal. Once the achievement is done, the coal can be retrieved again.

tasks.name: I Can Seer My House From Here
tasks.desc: Find the highest point in Seers' Village.
tasks.notes: Find the highest point in Seers' Village.

tasks.name: Mastering the Elements
tasks.desc: Defeat each type of elemental in the Elemental Workshop.
tasks.notes:
Defeat each type of elemental in the elemental workshop.
Defeating the earth elemental from Mining will also count. So will killing a fire elemental near the dust devils in the Smoke Dungeon.

tasks.name: It's Only a Model
tasks.desc: Teleport to Camelot.
tasks.notes:
Teleport to Camelot.
The Camelot teleport spell is only available in the standard spellbook.
The Camelot teleport tablets do not work for this achievement; neither will a player-owned house portal.

tasks.name: Sniper Training
tasks.desc: Kill one guard on each tower of the Ranging Guild using a regular longbow.
tasks.notes:
Kill one Tower Archer on each tower of the Ranging Guild using a regular longbow.
Enter the guild and go up the ladder in the middle of the guild. From the centre tower, kill 1 Tower Archer at each of the 4 towers on the corners of the guild. They range in level from 14 to 56 (north tower: level 14, east: 28, south: 42, west: 56), so you may need to bring food and prayer potions (for Protect from Ranged), if you have a low Ranged level. All 4 need to be killed in one go, so don't go back down the ladder until you've killed 1 at each tower. The final blow to each archer must be done with a regular longbow (oak longbow or above will not count). Alternatively players can kill them with whatever Ranged weapon they want if they switch to longbow while the finishing blow is travelling to their target.

tasks.name: Arch Archer
tasks.desc: Have the Ranging Guild judge congratulate you for acquiring over 1,000 archery tickets.
tasks.notes:
Have the Competition Judge from the Ranging Guild competition congratulate the player for acquiring at least 1,000 archery tickets. Contrary to the in-game description, the player does not need more than 1,000 tickets.
Bring some coins for the entrance fee (200 coins per game). Players with a high Ranged level with good bonuses, may likely play about 40 games before obtaining 1,000 tickets so bring 6,000-10,000 coins to pay for the multiple tries it will take. Players with level 70+ Ranged with a yew bow should be able to complete it in less than 25 turns. Lower-level players may have to play closer to 100 games, so bring 20,000 coins. Alternatively, players can buy 1,000 tickets from the Grand Exchange for 189,000 coins.

tasks.name: What, No Cuddly Toy?
tasks.desc: Buy something from the ticket exchange in the Ranging Guild.
tasks.notes:
Buy something from the Ticket Exchange in the Ranging Guild.
The studded leather coif is the cheapest at 12 archery tickets.

tasks.name: Familiar Fire Familiarity
tasks.desc: Use a familiar to make a maple fire within Seers' Village.
tasks.notes: Use a pyrelord or forge regent familiar to make a fire with maple logs within Seers' Village.

tasks.name: At Least It Doesn't Need Walking
tasks.desc: Get a pet fish from Harry.
other: 42 Crafting Crafting (to craft a fishbowl)
tasks.notes:
Get a pet fish from Harry by using a tiny net (can be bought from Harry, at a cost of 10 coins each).
Players must first fill a fishbowl with water, use seaweed with the water-filled fishbowl, and then talk to Harry or the option to buy the tiny net will not appear.

tasks.name: All Your Bass...
tasks.desc: Catch and cook a bass in Catherby.
tasks.notes:
Catch a raw bass in Catherby beach at a Net/Harpoon fishing spot, and then cook it either at a fire or at the range in the building north of the bank.
Burning the fish will not count for this achievement.

Teleport to the Ranging Guild with a combat bracelet which has at least one charge.
Teleporting using a jewellery box will not complete this achievement.

tasks.name: See Yew at Five
tasks.desc: Cut five sets of yew logs. (X/5)
tasks.notes: Cut five sets of yew logs. The logs must be cut from the yew trees found in the Seers' Village area, otherwise it will not count. Using the inferno adze will only count cut logs if they are not incinerated. A grace of the elves can be used during this task to cut down on banking.

tasks.name: The Short of It
tasks.desc: String a magic shortbow in Seers' Village bank.
tasks.notes: String a magic shortbow in the Seers' Village bank by adding a bowstring to a magic shortbow (u).

tasks.name: Prayer of Attorney
tasks.desc: Enter the Seers' Village courthouse with your Piety prayer turned on.
tasks.notes:
Enter the Seers' Village courthouse with the Piety prayer turned on.
The Seers' Village courthouse is located south of the bank. Entering the courthouse and then turning on Piety will not work, players must first enable Piety and then walk in.

tasks.name: Beware of the Dog
tasks.desc: Use the fairy ring in McGrubor's Wood.
quests: A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen
tasks.notes:
Use the fairy ring (code ALS) in McGrubor's Wood.
Dramen staff or lunar staff are required, unless A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift has been completed.

tasks.name: Twisted Fire Starter
tasks.desc: Burn a magic log in Seers' Village.
tasks.notes:
Burn a magic log in Seers' Village.
Players can use a tinderbox (can be on tool belt) or a pyrelord or forge regent familiar; using a bow doesn't work.

tasks.name: Alch-aholic
tasks.desc: Cast High-level Alchemy on a magic shortbow in Seers' Village bank.
tasks.notes:
Cast High Level Alchemy on a magic shortbow in Seers' Village bank.
It is easier to use High Level Alchemy on the bow that was made for the achievement, The Short of It, rather than to buy another one.
It is also possible to use explorer's ring 4, a radiant alchemist's amulet, or a legendary pet's ability for this achievement.

tasks.name: Gonna Need a Bigger Boat
tasks.desc: Catch five sharks in Catherby.
tasks.notes:
Catch five sharks at Catherby beach.
Alternatively, players can catch a shark at level 71 Fishing if an admiral pie is used, or at level 73 if a fish pie or fishing potion is used.
Catching two sharks at once only counts as one in the achievement. Great white sharks do count towards this achievement.

tasks.name: Gonna Need a Bigger Range
tasks.desc: Cook five sharks on the range north of Catherby bank using the cooking gauntlets.
tasks.notes:
Cook five sharks in Catherby using the cooking gauntlets.
Either range can be used. Burnt sharks do not count towards the five, and they do not have to be cooked all at once. Great white sharks also do not count towards the five, despite counting for Gonna Need a Bigger Boat. The sharks can be cooked at level 76 with a Chef's delight, or at level 75 with a Chef's delight (m).

tasks.name: Water Palaver
tasks.desc: Charge five water orbs in one go.
tasks.notes:
Charge five water orbs in one go at the Obelisk of Water on the island south of Catherby beach.
The player must use the standard Magic spellbook and cast a Charge Water Orb on the Obelisk of Water using 150 water runes or a staff supplying water runes, 15 cosmic runes, and 5 unpowered orbs.
Teleport to the Taverley lodestone, walk south (either using the stepping stones agility shortcut or walking around over the bridge), then enter the Taverley Dungeon. From there, head towards the north-west corner of the dungeon, using either the Agility shortcut (requires 70 agility) or walking around the dungeon (requires a dusty key). You are looking for the ladder next to the black dragons which will lead you back to the surface, next to the Obelisk of Water. In the dungeon, level 64 poison spiders can be encountered; their poison can halt the orb-making process, resulting in orbs being made but the achievement not being completed. Therefore, bring an antipoison potion. It's recommended to bring a mithril grapple and crossbow for the next achievement, Island Hopper.

tasks.name: Island Hopper
tasks.desc: Use the grapple shortcut to get from the water obelisk island to Catherby beach.
tasks.notes: Use the grapple shortcut to get from the Obelisk of Water island to Catherby beach. A mithril grapple and a crossbow are required to use the shortcut. You must enter the Taverley Dungeon, climb the ladder at the black dragons area, then grapple the grapple column and you will complete this achievement. Alternatively, one can use the hidey-hole or the enhanced grappling hook (on the tool belt).

tasks.name: It's a Trap! No, Wait, It's a Pie
tasks.desc: Make an admiral pie from scratch within Seers' Village/Catherby.
tasks.notes:
Bake an admiral pie from scratch within the Seers' Village and Catherby area.
It is possible to go to the achievement in the interface to see whether a step has been counted. All of the steps mentioned in the achievements description must be completed inside the area. The only items which are allowed to be brought from elsewhere are potato seeds, pot of flour, some water, a pie dish and the tools to fish with. The water and pie dish can be found in the house with the cooking range, north of the bank in Catherby. The salmon can only be caught in the lake north of Seers' Village bank, make sure you do not have Rainbow Fish selected for featherless fly fishing by going into the Settings → Gameplay → Skills and experience → Construction → Aquarium settings → Featherless Fly fishing. The tuna can be harpooned at the Catherby shore fishing spots. A potato must be farmed in Catherby to complete the achievement. Players can fetch flour out of Sinclair Mansion if they have none and don't want to leave the area, they will need an empty pot to put it in.
The Bake Pie spell will not work and a range must be used.

subs.html: Fish raw salmon (south west of Sinclair Mansion, bring feathers for lure fishing) and raw tuna (east of Catherby docks, cage/harpoon fishing spot) and cook them.

Farm a raw potato. A potato can be farmed in Catherby to complete the achievement. Potato seeds require 40 minutes to harvest (you can use Supreme growth potion (sundry) to speed up the process). Taking a potato from the Sinclair Mansion vegetable patch will not work. Stealing a potato from the Vegetable Stalls in Catherby will not work.

Make pastry dough and use it on a pie dish to create a pie shell. (If not buying on GE, pie dish and bucket of water spawn in the house north of the Catherby bank. A pot can be bought from the grocery store, Arhein's Store, on the Catherby docks, and it can be filled at the Mill Road Mill or in the kitchen (flour barrel) of the Sinclair Mansion.)
Make raw admiral pie. Add a cooked salmon and cooked tuna to the pie shell. Then add a raw potato that has been harvested from a patch in Catherby.
Bake the raw admiral pie on a cooking range in Catherby or Seers' Village. This step cannot be done until all the preceding steps have been completed.

tasks.name: Make a Bolt For It
tasks.desc: Make an enchanted diamond-tipped bolt from scratch within the Seers' Village area.
tasks.notes:
Make an enchanted diamond-tipped crossbow bolt from scratch within the Seers' Village area.
Each step needs to be completed within the area, and the achievement will be updated in the achievement tab as steps are completed. The adamant bar, diamond, and feathers can be brought in.

subs.html: Fletch bolt with feather and add bolt tip
Cast Enchant Crossbow Bolt (Diamond) on the bolts

tasks.name: The Long of It
tasks.desc: Make a magic longbow from scratch within the Seers' Village area. (X/4)
tasks.notes:
Make a magic longbow from scratch within the Seers' Village area.
Each step needs to be completed within the area, and the achievement will be updated in the achievement tab as steps are completed. The magic logs can be brought in.

subs.html: Pick and spin flax

tasks.name: Plenty - potion - entiary
tasks.desc: Make an extreme Ranging potion from scratch and drink it within the Ranging Guild.
other: The following is not required if grenwall spikes are obtained as a drop:
tasks.notes:
Make an extreme ranging potion from scratch and drink it within the Ranging Guild.
Each step needs to be completed within the area. Bring the ingredients for a super ranging potion (ingredients can be brought in from outside the area), make it inside the Ranging Guild, add the five grenwall spikes, and finally drink one dose. The achievement will be updated in the achievement as steps are completed. Boosts can be used but must remain when drinking the potion.

tasks.name: Moon Raker
tasks.desc: Cast Fertile Soil on a patch within the Seers' Village area.
tasks.notes:
Cast Fertile Soil on a farming patch in Catherby or the hops patch north-west of Seers' Village.
The allotment south of the Ranging Guild will not work.
